subject.title: Built-in skill 'summarize' only supports brew install, no feedback when enable fails

question: Should the bundled summarize skill remain in OpenClaw core, and if so what installer/platform contract should it advertise?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent fix depends on maintainer ownership of the summarize package source, supported platforms, and whether this optional skill should remain bundled or move out to ClawHub/self-install.

options.title: Keep bundled with verified installer
options.body: Approve a maintained installer source only after ownership, Node/runtime compatibility, and live Linux/macOS install proof are checked, then update metadata, UI feedback, and tests.

options.title: Remove or de-bundle summarize
options.body: Stop shipping the broken bundled skill and let summarize live as a ClawHub or self-managed skill until a maintained installer contract exists.

options.title: Mark platform-specific support
options.body: Keep the bundled skill only for explicitly supported platforms and make unsupported Linux/Docker states visible in status and install UI.

recommendation.title: Keep bundled with verified installer
recommendation.body: Approve a maintained installer source only after ownership, Node/runtime compatibility, and live Linux/macOS install proof are checked, then update metadata, UI feedback, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The summarize metadata and package-source history point most directly to steipete for the bundled source/platform decision.
